checkpoints.description: [1/4] Plan: Integrate NoMoreClutter into AIKit as a compliant managed project

impact_assessment.why: NoMoreClutter contains legacy embedded governance scripts and docs from before AIKit became a centralized multi-project cockpit; integrating it establishes full gate compliance, clean .aikit/ memory, and modern AIKit project architecture
impact_assessment.benefits: aikit check nomoreclutter passes 4/4 gates (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets); legacy duplication eliminated; codebase map and ADR history preserved in .aikit/
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no breaking changes to NoMoreClutter features; dependency: stdlib and existing project deps only; concurrency: none; state: preserve ADRs in .aikit/decisions.md and keep test suite passing
impact_assessment.mitigation: verify tests after each change; annotate legitimate best-effort handlers with hygiene markers; run full aikit check in Phase 4

checkpoints.description: [1/4] Cleaned up obsolete embedded AIKit files, migrated ADR-001 through ADR-019 to .aikit/decisions.md and recorded ADR-020
[2/4] Guidelines gate green: updated README, fixed stubs in test responses, eliminated open-outside-with, added FileExecutor.reset_state(), and synchronized codebase_map.md
[3/4] Resolved all 27 hygiene findings across UI components and eliminated console UnicodeEncodeError on Windows
[4/4] Phase 4 complete: all 130 tests pass, 4/4 delivery gates pass (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets), checklists: passed
